messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: CS Team <cs-team@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@sentrywell.com>
Cc: procurement@sentrywell.com
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: SentryWell — Sales to CS intake and implementation notes

Team,

Quick handoff for SentryWell (they signed last Friday). High-level context and asks below — please assign an owner and confirm next steps by EOD tomorrow.

Deal summary:
- Contract: Annual committed usage, 12-month term, start date target 2026-12-01.
- Monthly committed tokens: 1.2B tokens (expecting burst pattern: 80% of traffic between 9am–6pm US ET).
- Primary contact: Alex Moreno (Head of Platform) — alex.moreno@sentrywell.com. Procurement looped (procurement@sentrywell.com).
- Deal ID: RDW-2026-1149.

Success criteria (customer):
1) API latency at p50 < 120ms for 512-token requests during peak hours.
2) End-to-end authenticated deployment with SSO (Okta) + audit logs visible in Console.
3) Full ingestion of their 3 canonical prompt templates and baseline quality tests run against internal eval set.

Key dates / timeline:
- 2026-11-29: Finalize SOW and start internal kickoff prep.
- 2026-12-01: Planned go-live window (they have a soft launch on 12/03).

Known technical constraints / notes:
- They will want private deployment on a dedicated pool for the first 60 days (we agreed to a Dedicated pool evaluation).
- Data residency: US-only. They will not send PHI but will ask for audit log retention 1 year.
- Network: customer will terminate on-prem peering; see attached network_diagram.png for their topology.

Attachments: 20261122_SentryWell_MA_Pricing.pdf (commercial summary), SOW-draft-v1.docx (initial SOW), network_diagram.png

Asks for CS:
- Assign a primary CS owner and a technical lead for the kickoff.
- Reconcile SOW items and confirm any scope gaps with Legal/Finance by 11/29.
- Confirm required evidence for procurement (SOC 2 in particular) and whether we need a security review call.
- Prepare a 30/60/90 activation plan with roles and a first-kickoff agenda.

Background notes for the owner:
- We ran a 2-week pilot in Oct and validated model responses for their core templates; there were two latency regressions during peak that we traced to request fanout — infra changes scheduled in the dedicated pool should mitigate.
- Pricing is committed; there's a discretionary 10% credit if we miss latency SLA in month 1.

Alex — feel free to add anything I missed.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks Ben — taking this on. A few clarifying Qs before I spin up the kickoff doc: 

1) Concurrency / QPS profile: can you share their expected sustained RPS during peak (we have tokens but need rps estimates to size the pool)?
2) Okta SSO: will SentryWell provide an IdP metadata endpoint or do they want us to initiate the integration?
3) Audit logs retention request (1 year) — do we have an existing T&C clause that covers that or will Legal need to sign off on storage sizing?

I'll draft the 30/60/90 and propose owners — prelim plan is to assign Vivek as primary implementation lead and me as the onboarding sponsor. Vivek — can you confirm capacity for a dec 1 kickoff?

Irene
